display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea-Hypopnea Index: (Obstructive apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal +mixed apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with >= 3% oxygen desaturation or with arousal) / hour of sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - PATS AHI (all obstructive apneas, all mixed apneas, plus hypopneas with 3% or arousal)
calculation: 60*(oarbp +oarop + oanbp + oanop + marbp + marop + manrbp + manrop +  hremba3 +hroa3 + hnrba3 + hnroa3)/slpprdp
